packageRules.description: LinuxServer stopped publishing plain semver tags for Jellyfin 12+; the multi-arch tag is now version-<major>.<minor>[.<patch>]ubu<ubuntu-release> (e.g. version-12.1ubu2604). Docker's default versioning can't parse that, so spell it out here. Anchoring on the version- prefix also excludes the per-build -lsNN tags and plain tags, which would otherwise look like unrelated/older versions.
